adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework completed for JVI.00635-20. The final paper remains publication-grade with cautions: supported antiviral IC50 values and fusion-mechanism claims are retained, DRAMP/CAMP database conflicts are preserved, and unsupported supplement/figure-only or broad antimicrobial claims are not promoted.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary methods state all peptides are N-acetylated/C-amidated and lipopeptides are cholesterol-conjugated at the C-terminal lysine; DRAMP raw metadata stores N-terminal Free and incomplete/normalized C-terminal modification fields.
CAMP linked experiment rows include generic SARS-CoV-2-S titles and Gram labels not supported by the antiviral primary paper, even where sequence/value text can be mapped to Figure 1/Table 1.
Primary Table 1 reports IPB05 VSV-G pseudovirus IC50 as >50 μM, while the DBAASP linked assay row reports >25 μM; the row remains source_conflict, not source_verified.

Local primary material supports fusion/pseudovirus inhibition and peptide synthesis, but no source-reviewed cytotoxicity or hemolysis table was found; database “no information found” notes are preserved as absence, not measured safety.
Final activity excludes helix content and Tm columns that the framework parser previously emitted as IC50-like rows.
